```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ISLR)
library(MASS)
```


```{r}
data(Auto)
auto=data.frame(Auto)
```

```{r}
?Auto
```

```{r}
view(Auto)

```



```{r}
attach(Auto)
```


```{r}
dim(Auto)
```


```{r}
mpg01<-rep(0,nrow(Auto))
mpg01[Auto[,'mpg']>median(Auto[,'mpg'])]<-1
mpg01=as.factor(mpg01)
auto01=data.frame(Auto,mpg01)
table(mpg01)
```
```{r}
view(mpg01)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
boxplot(acceleration~mpg01,auto01,main="Accel~mpg01")
boxplot(weight~mpg01,auto01,main="weight~mpg01")
boxplot(horsepower~mpg01,auto01,main="horsep~mpg01")
boxplot(displacement~mpg01,auto01,main="disp~mpg01")
```

```{r}
training_data=auto01[1:196,]
testing_data=auto01[196:392,]
```

```{r}
glm_data=glm(mpg01~horsepower+displacement,family=binomial,training_data)
summary(glm_data)

```
```{r}
logit.pred=predict(glm_data,testing_data[,c('horsepower','weight','displacement')])
logit.class=ifelse(logit.pred>0.5,1,0)
table(logit.class,testing_data[,'mpg01']) 
```
```{r}
(65+95)/(65+35+2+95)
```
